children.role_hint: Single-ended complementary CMOS OTA core. The NMOS and PMOS input devices form complementary transconductance paths driven by vin and vip, with vo as the single-ended output. M5 is the PMOS current source biased by ib_sink, while M2 is an internally self-controlled NMOS tail device whose gate is driven by net2.
